g.text: Famous Acrobat and circus front woman
dumped cause he was too dumb, cute though
concerned his science may bring a true darkness to the colony
bought a potion that worked really well
trespassed on his family estate after meeting Evaan
long conversation in the North Port library
politely removed from church grounds for Sebastian
respects his MANY years of experience
hired to move some rare books
has suggestion on the potency of his potions
jealous of his confidence and stalked a little
met at circus found his demeanor fascinating
